channel.title: Jlisten2me Journal
channel.description: Articles on carrying things you can't hand to the people around you.

item.title: When you're getting divorced and your friends are picking sides
item.description: You're getting divorced, mutual friends have gone quiet or drifted to your ex, and the invitations stopped. Somewhere to say it.

item.title: When you have to decide and can't tell anyone yet
item.description: A decision about layoffs, runway, or selling, and everyone you'd normally tell has a stake in it. Somewhere to say it first.
